problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$S=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 4 & 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$Z=[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ 1 & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}]$
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(Z) & ={z}_{11}{C}_{11}+{z}_{12}{C}_{12}+{z}_{13}{C}_{13}+{z}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{C}_{11} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot |\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & -2 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 3 & 2 \\ ∗ & 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 0 \\ 5 & 3 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 3 & 8\end{aligned}|-(-2)\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 2 & 8\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}|) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(0+2(5\cdot 8-2\cdot 2)+0) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 72 \\  & =36\end{aligned}
$$
